scope: Spline phi_bins Phi12, 3D Bayesian only, on a copy of fits/spline/phi_bins/Phi12/fit_copy.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms, 12 phi bins. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume. A is the 30-degree yield amplitude and was not divided by two.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows for these 452 histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.0070 with 445 narrower than 0.05, so those windows can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the manual baseline and the corrected filled-window range. It improved 7 and made 15 worse. The manual key for (1,8) is B limits [-0.05, 0.05], so the fit only moved from the pinned B=-0.045000, statistical error 0.022644, C=0.004680, error 0.008729, chi-squared 33.667, NDF 5, to B=-0.057994 with C collapsed at 0 and chi-squared 32.856. Bins whose manual key has no start, including (1,18), were driven off a cosine the stored fit already had. Pass 2 put 40 starts on each missed histogram's own cosine, opened a limit only when it excluded that cosine, and turned off the second-pass half-width window when |B| or |C| was below 0.05. It refit Q2-y 1-12 and 14-16. Q2-y 13 and 17 were not refit; their 51 histograms already matched the stored fit after pass 1. Two windows still included the old manual edge, and the second pass walked off the cosine: (5,9) chi-squared 13.306 to 25.975 and (12,24) 38.545 to 41.329. Pass 3 tightened only those two onto the cosine, turned off the half-width window, and refit Q2-y 5 and 12. JSON still has 452 bins. 32 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is higher (largest increase 0.000391). Largest drops: (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_29) 34.201 to 25.076; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_23) 37.236 to 28.285; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_17) 33.416 to 24.490; (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_34) 14.734 to 6.231; (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_2) 56.302 to 48.366; (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) 21.742 to 13.962; (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_28) 25.714 to 18.245; (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_29) 28.919 to 21.500. (1,8) is kept at B=-0.096367, statistical error 0.031667, C=-0.027127, error 0.030315, chi-squared 31.193, NDF 5, status completed, phi 60-300, 8 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. That is this 12-bin histogram's cosine, not the nominal B=-0.125184. The nominal-minus-variation B shift is now +0.028817 instead of the pinned +0.080184.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_3) B=-0.08563 versus nominal -0.17087; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_2) B=-0.05263 versus nominal -0.11743; (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_6) B=-0.36426 versus nominal -0.31371; (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_2) B=-0.14645 versus nominal -0.19217; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_15) B=-0.07525 versus nominal -0.11743; (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_7) B=-0.38938 versus nominal -0.42829. (6,6) stays at C=0.060000 versus its free cosine 0.065; the chi-squared gap is 0.362 and the shape does not change. (5,7) keeps a collapsed cos(2phi) error. Its free C is 0.017 and the chi-squared gap is 0.494, so the limit was not opened. (1,9), (1,10), (5,25), and (8,21) also keep a collapsed error on an amplitude consistent with zero. Those collapsed errors are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and they are not added to the systematic budget. Excluded sector pairs were not put back into this comparison. No comparison was filled with zero. The phi_bins source was not removed. The budget's factor of one half on A is not applied inside this fit.
unresolved: The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. The retained A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) already matches an unconstrained cosine, so another guide change would not help. (1,8) is not unresolved as a guide miss: the retained curve matches the free cosine, and the remaining chi-squared is scatter inside 60-300. Isolated spikes that the cosine already follows: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_2) pull -5.76 at 225 deg; (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_10) pull -5.20 at 45 deg. No empty histograms.
why_retained: Pass 3 is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, 32 are lower by more than 0.05, and the curves follow each Phi12 histogram. (1,8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed, and A was not divided by two. Near-zero second-pass errors are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic.
